name: @mobilebiz/vonage-mcp-server
description: Vonage SMS and Voice MCP Server - Send SMS and make voice calls using Vonage API
long_description: This extension provides Model Context Protocol (MCP) server capabilities for Vonage, allowing AI assistants to send SMS messages and make voice calls through the Vonage API.

vonage_application_id.title: Vonage Application ID
vonage_application_id.description: Your Vonage Application ID from the Vonage Developer Portal

vonage_private_key_path.title: Private Key Path
vonage_private_key_path.description: Full path to your Vonage private key file (e.g., /Users/your-name/vonage/private.key)

enable_sms.title: Enable SMS
enable_sms.description: Enable send_sms and get_sms_status. Must be exactly "true" or "false" (lowercase). Every capability is OFF by default: with all three left as "false" this server exposes no tools at all. Turn on only what you intend to use — these tools spend money and reach real people.

enable_voice.title: Enable Voice
enable_voice.description: Enable make_voice_call and get_call_status. Must be exactly "true" or "false" (lowercase). Every capability is OFF by default: with all three left as "false" this server exposes no tools at all. Turn on only what you intend to use — these tools spend money and reach real people.

vonage_voice_from.title: Voice Call From Number
vonage_voice_from.description: Phone number to use for voice calls in E.164 format (e.g., 81345438093). Required only when Enable Voice is "true".

allowed_numbers.title: Allowed Numbers (optional)
allowed_numbers.description: Comma-separated whitelist of destination numbers in E.164 format (e.g., +819012345678,+819087654321). Leave empty to allow any number.

rate_limit_per_hour.title: Rate Limit Per Hour
rate_limit_per_hour.description: Maximum number of messages per hour, counted across SMS and voice together (not per tool). Bulk sending consumes one unit per message. Set to 0 to reject every send (0 is an emergency stop, NOT "no limit").
